app: Manual Camera (Play title; no 'Pro' in the title)
basis: docs https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.vipek.camera2 as of 2026-10-20 (v3.9, updated Aug 17, 2025, $3.99). Developer on Play and at geekydevs.com is Geeky Devs Studio; 'vipek' survives only in the package name. Neither Play nor geekydevs.com has a manual or help page, so the listing is the only official source; three items from a user forum are marked '(forum report)'.

features.name: Auto mode
features.what: App starts fully automatic; each parameter is unlocked separately from there
features.match_note: each manual strip starts on auto

features.name: Lock
features.what: Locks one parameter (shutter, focus, ISO, WB or EV) at a time to take it out of auto

features.name: Wheel
features.what: On-screen rotating wheel that adjusts the locked parameter
features.match_note: strip slider instead of a wheel

features.name: Manual Shutter Speed
features.what: Sets the exposure time by hand

features.name: Manual Focus Distance
features.what: Sets the focus distance by hand

features.name: Manual Exposure Compensation
features.what: Brightens or darkens the auto exposure

features.name: RAW (DNG)
features.what: Saves a DNG raw file (forum users report JPEG or JPEG+RAW, no RAW-only)

features.name: Sounds On/Off
features.what: Turns app/shutter sounds on or off

features.name: Max. Screen Brightness On/Off
features.what: Forces full screen brightness while the app is open

features.name: Volume keys as shutter
features.what: (forum report) Volume buttons trigger the shutter
features.match_note: volume keys step the active manual control; only the camera key / headset hook fire the shutter (KeyPressedController, no census entry)

features.name: Portrait orientation
features.what: (forum report) UI works in portrait as well as landscape
features.match_note: GlassCam's UI is locked to landscape; controls do not rotate (no portrait)

features.name: Settings kept after quitting
features.what: (forum report) Manual settings persist across app launches
features.match_note: settings, camera and module persist across launches
